title: DNS Tunneling Exfiltration -- High Volume Unique Subdomain Covert Channel (T1071.004 Megalodon Variant C)
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects potential DNS tunneling by identifying source IPs generating abnormally high volumes of unique subdomain queries, indicative of data encoding in DNS labels.
Detection mechanism (SIEM-side aggregation required; Sigma does not natively express count/distinct, so this template documents the thresholding logic in `falsepositives` and `level: high` annotations for backend translation):
- source_ip generating >500 DNS queries in a 5-minute rolling window - AND with >200 distinct subdomain labels (count(distinct QueryName)) - AND query labels exhibit high entropy (base32/base62 encoding hint) - OPTIONAL enrichment: query parent domain matches a known DNS tunneling C2 list (e.g., t.m-kosche.com Mini Shai-Hulud R88-56 cluster anchor documented in internal) OR matches a heuristic newly-registered domain (NRD) age <30 days
Threat context (H Wave 8 Front 3 Sigma Coverage Gap Matrix MEG-C):
(1) Megalodon Variant C uses DNS exfiltration as a covert channel fallback when HTTPS egress is blocked or monitored. Implementation: attacker malware encodes stolen credentials in DNS query labels (e.g., `<base32-encoded-payload>.exfil.attacker-controlled.com`), and a DNS resolver at the attacker side reassembles the payload from the resolver query stream.
(2) Detection target = source IP query rate + unique subdomain cardinality. Legitimate high-DNS-volume clients (CDN resolvers, internal monitoring) produce HIGH query rate but LOW unique subdomain count; exfil tunneling produces HIGH query rate AND HIGH unique subdomain count = the discriminator.
(3) Current corpus (61 rules pre-R89-11d) has template_t1071_application_layer_protocol_c2_over_http_https.yml (T1071 HTTP/HTTPS C2) but NO T1071.004 sub-technique DNS-specific rule. This fills the gap.
Sister rule cluster: observed_mini_shai_hulud_npm_supply_chain_c2_t1071 (HTTPS C2 in Nx campaign cluster) + this rule (DNS C2 channel form).
Source: Tier 0 first-party H Wave 8 adversarial layer-3 deepdive Front 3 Sigma Coverage Gap Matrix (internal MEG-C variant; 0 DNS exfil rule in pre-R89-11d corpus identified).
